model.revision_note: sha256 verified via shasum against HuggingFace's x-linked-etag header (exact match); ftype metadata not used to identify the variant (see docs/OPTIMIZATION-QWEN38-2026-09-17.md, this file family's own metadata-labeling quirk).
model.quantization: ternary g128 PQ2_0 (2.16 bpw packed, 1.72 bpw true)

gguf_metadata_confirmed.note: sampling.* is the GGUF's own embedded default; go-agent still sends explicit sampling params from profiles.go rather than relying on it.

policy.backend_note: Ternary Bonsai 2 27B PQ2_0 is a ternary quant of the same Qwen3.8-27B base already screened at IQ3_XXS (docs/OPTIMIZATION-QWEN38-2026-09-17.md: 3 attempts, 0 fixes, 1 regression). Every published Bonsai 2 benchmark number is thinking mode at xhigh reasoning effort with temp 1.0/top_p 0.95/top_k 20 -- confirmed both by the whitepaper's evaluation-methodology section and by this GGUF's own embedded general.sampling.* metadata -- so this config runs thinking ON, unlike the qwen38-local config which forced --reasoning off. Requires the PrismML-Eng prism-branch llama.cpp fork; stock llama-server (b10809) cannot load ternary/Hadamard-rotated GGUFs. --reasoning-format deepseek routes thinking into message.reasoning_content, which go-agent/protocol.go already reads natively. Tool calls: the model's chat template emits <tool_call><function=name><parameter=x> XML; with --jinja the prism fork's server returns this as structured message.tool_calls (confirmed via the Bonsai-demo repo's TOOLS.md), and go-agent's recovery_qwenxml.go is an existing fallback parser for the same shape if any of it ever leaks into content as text.

experiments.hypothesis: Ternary Bonsai 2 27B PQ2_0, run in thinking mode at its own documented xhigh reasoning effort and sampling, fits fully GPU-resident at 32K context on this M1/16GB (real headroom versus the 24576-context ceiling measured for the larger Qwen3.8 IQ3_XXS) and can complete a native-tool-call, objectively-graded real-repair attempt on immer-array-push-fix.
